n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I'm in bed! Mr Buttons is here too. Tell me a story from Iran! Please!

translations.fa: تو تختم! آقای دکمه هم اینجاست. یه قصه از ایران بگو! لطفاً!

branches.suggestion: Once upon a time, there was a big bird.
branches.suggestionFa: یکی بود یکی نبود، یه پرندهٔ بزرگ بود.

branches.suggestion: OK. Do you want a story about a king?
branches.suggestionFa: باشه. یه قصه دربارهٔ یه پادشاه می‌خوای؟

newWords.fa: روزی روزگاری ؛ یکی بود یکی نبود

cultureNote.en: Persian stories often start "Yeki bood, yeki nabood" — "One was, one wasn't" — like "Once upon a time".

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: A big bird! How big? Bigger than a bus?

translations.fa: یه پرندهٔ بزرگ! چقدر بزرگ؟ بزرگ‌تر از اتوبوس؟

branches.suggestion: Bigger than a house! Her name was Simorgh.
branches.suggestionFa: بزرگ‌تر از یه خونه! اسمش سیمرغ بود.

branches.suggestion: She was as big as a mountain!
She lived on top of a high mountain.
branches.suggestionFa: بالای یه کوه بلند زندگی می‌کرد.

branches.suggestion: In a nest in a magic tree.
branches.suggestionFa: تو یه لونه رو یه درخت جادویی.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Ooh. Was she kind or scary?

branches.suggestion: She was very kind and very wise.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی مهربون و خیلی دانا بود.

branches.suggestion: She was kind, but she was scary to bad people!
branches.suggestionFa: مهربون بود، ولی برای آدم‌های بد ترسناک بود!

branches.suggestion: One day, she found a little baby boy.
branches.suggestionFa: یه روز، یه پسر بچه پیدا کرد.

branches.suggestion: She saved a baby on the mountain.
branches.suggestionFa: یه بچه را رو کوه نجات داد.

recasts.echo: She found a baby? Then what?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: A baby! Like William was? Did she look after him?

translations.fa: یه بچه! مثل ویلیام وقتی کوچیک بود؟ ازش مراقبت کرد؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. She looked after him for years.
She gave him food and kept him warm.
branches.suggestionFa: بهش غذا داد و گرمش نگه داشت.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Like Nana looks after William! Then what happened? Did he grow up?

translations.fa: مثل نانا که از ویلیام مراقبت می‌کنه! بعد چی شد؟ بزرگ شد؟

branches.suggestion: He grew up and became a hero.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Tomorrow night?! OK… Simorgh is my favourite now. Night night, {you}. Night night, Simorgh…

translations.fa: فردا شب؟! باشه… الان سیمرغ محبوب منه. شب بخیر {you}. شب بخیر سیمرغ…
